candidates.title: Will the President's approval rating be between 38.0 and 38.2 according to RealClearPolitics?
candidates.rules_primary: If the President's approval rating is between 38.0 and 38.2% at 11:00 AM ET on November 27, 2026 according to RealClearPolitics, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The market will determine at 11:00 AM ET on November 27, 2026.

candidates.title: Will it rain in Lexington on Nov 26, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLILEX in Lexington in Nov 26, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Data for CLILEX can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 46-47° on Nov 26, 2026?

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

candidates.title: Will CPI rise more than 0.2% in November 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 0.2% (single-decimal) in November 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The market will always close at 8:29 AM ET on the scheduled day of the data release (December 10, 2026). Please note: the Expiration Value is the single-decimal value published at the Source Agency. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

candidates.title: Will the Republican party win the Senate in 2028?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Republican party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market may be determined early based on a consensus of media calls projecting control of the U.S. Senate. See full rules for details. Otherwise, victory will be determined by the party identification of the President pro tempore of the Senate on February 1, 2029.

candidates.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 27, 2026 be above $1.30?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 27, 2026 is above $1.30, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will Canada’s annual inflation rate for November 2026 be above 2.9%?
candidates.rules_primary: If Canada’s annual inflation rate for November 2026 is above 2.9%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The annual inflation rate compares Canada’s all-items CPI for November 2026 with its level in the same month one year earlier.

candidates.title: Will a bill ending self rule in Washington DC become law before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.yes_sub_title: A bill ending self rule in Washington DC
candidates.rules_primary: If a bill ending self rule in Washington DC becomes law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 (ET), then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2027 be above 4.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2027 is above 4.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2027 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2027, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Lorie Logan as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Lorie Logan is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 (ET). then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President (or President-elect) of Lorie Logan's nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.
